summary: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 will become the preferred model powering Microsoft 365 Copilot across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat and Cowork, served via the OpenAI API.

mechanisms.reason: GPT-5.6 is being deployed as the default model across a mass-scale productivity surface used by millions of people daily.
mechanisms.quote: Microsoft 365 is where millions of people write, analyze, create, and collaborate every day

categories.reason: The announcement is specifically about a model being distributed through and powering a major hyperscale platform's flagship product.
categories.quote: GPT‑5.6, which will become the new preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot—in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat and Cowork

practices.reason: The model is claimed to deliver better performance per dollar, but no benchmark or figure is given to act on.
practices.quote: GPT‑5.6 is OpenAI’s latest flagship model series, which delivers more useful work from every token, with stronger performance per dollar and on demand capability for the most complex tasks.
